description: Changing the pilot country from Serbia to North Macedonia before G0 required edits to about thirty files because country, chapter, dates, languages and examples were written into the codebooks, procedures and rules.
scaling_implication: Every new country or chapter would have needed the same sweep. Keeping run-specific settings in the run record, CLAUDE.md and the limits log makes the method reusable.
recommendation: Keep method documents country-neutral; add a check before each new run that searches the method documents for country, chapter and date terms.

description: A scope combining one chapter with a cross-cutting theme (technology and AI) could not be expressed with chapter and cluster fields alone, so theme tags planned for a later stage had to be brought forward.
scaling_implication: Scaling across chapters and clusters will need more cross-cutting themes; the materiality test and scope basis need testing at G3 to G5 before more themes are added.
recommendation: Review how well the materiality test and the out_of_scope check work at G3 and G5 before defining further themes.

description: The helper tools depend on system software (text recognition with Macedonian and Albanian language data, PDF rendering) that was not installed in the working environment and was not recorded anywhere before stage 0.
scaling_implication: Each new country or language needs its own text recognition data and a test with a sample in that script before extraction starts.
recommendation: Keep tools/requirements.txt current; add a scanned sample in each new language to tools/tests/test_tools.py before a new country is added.
